description: An Italian polymath drew a domed, cannon-bristling car driven by cranks, a forerunner of the tank.
scene: A wooden model of a round, cone-roofed armoured vehicle like an upturned shallow bowl, small cannon barrels poking out all around its rim and a little turret on top, standing on a Renaissance workshop table among compasses and gear wheels; a robed, bearded figure seen from behind leans over it
